### Risk facts

- `public-contract` · [`recorder-store.ts:1109`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts#L1109) — The webcam sidecar metadata sent to recordingFinalize gains a new optional `gaps` field, which the editor reads back to seed hidden segments.
- `public-contract` · [`webcam-track.ts:72`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts#L72) — The on-disk sidecar's webcam field gains an optional `gaps` array (screen ms) that the editor now reads to seed hidden segments.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (5 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Camera toggled off during a take that records a webcam file parks the bubble instead of destroying it (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:309`) — The bubble disappears and both camera streams stop, so the in-use light goes off. The webcam file keeps holding its last frame. If it fails: If the renderer's getRecordingSettings rejects, the error is swallowed and the preview stays on until a broadcast arrives (camera-bubble.tsx:57). The broadcast that flipped the toggle arrives anyway,… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:299-335`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/camera-bubble-window.ts:262-271`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/camera-bubble/camera-bubble.tsx:44-61`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:769-778`.
- Finalize reads placedBounds for a parked bubble, then releases it (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:498`) — A take that ends with the camera off keeps its recorded bubble placement. If it fails: If finalize fails, the renderer calls recordingAbort, and abort also releases the parked bubble (recording-hub.ts:551-554). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:494-502`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:844-850`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:868`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:1042-1068`.
- Camera turned on again mid-take: the recorder reopens the camera and feeds the relay (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:779`) — The bubble comes back. If the re-open fails, the face goes to the screen and a toast appears after the take (recorder-store.ts:1018, 1069-1070). If it fails: The worst case is 2× WEBCAM_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS before the fallback starts. Until then nothing records the face. A take stopped mid-open answers "unavailable" and the stream is stopped. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:779-819`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:741-754`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:935-953`.
- Renderer-supplied webcam.gaps are cleaned up and written to the sidecar on finalize (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts:184`) — The editor turns each gap into a hidden webcam segment, in source seconds, stretched to at least the minimum segment length and kept inside the recording's duration when that is known. If it fails: A malformed gap is dropped silently. If no gap is usable, the key is left out, so the take reads like an old sidecar. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts:131-154`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:1017`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:1109`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-model.ts:135-158`.
- Camera off/on mid-take opens and closes a gap on the take's screen timeline (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:928`) — The editor lane stripes each gap, and exports hide the face there. If the camera cannot be reopened, the user gets a webcamUnavailable toast after the take is saved. If it fails: If the reopen gets no frame within WEBCAM_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS, the engine ends the file (endWebcam) and returns "unavailable". The store then stops trying to reopen for the rest of the take. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:926-952`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:806-809`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:769-819`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/webcam-gaps.ts:10-31`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** The main-process path holds up. The hub parks the bubble only while a take is actually recording a webcam file. Otherwise it destroys the bubble, and it also destroys a parked window whose webcam file has since ended. It releases parked windows at finalize, abort, stop and reset, and because the renderer sends finalize before stop, `placedBounds` is read while the window still exists. On the renderer side, `cameraRequest` supersession in the engine makes rapid off/on toggles safe. Two findings, both at "consider": the re-open can wait 2× `WEBCAM_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS` before falling back, while the docs and the PR's test step describe a single timeout; and a comment in the store describes a queueing mechanism the off path doesn't use. The PR states its two main platform assumptions itself (a hidden-then-shown window stays excluded from a running capture, and Insertable Streams exist in Electron 39). The code can't settle either; an owner has to check them on a real device.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found one minor issue in this part and nothing that should block the merge. The shared gap check (sanitizeWebcamGaps) and WebcamGapLog do what their tests say. The two updated docs match the code: camera off parks the window and keeps the file running, and the old rule still applies where there is no track generator and before the take begins. The issue: a comment in the relay test (`webcam-relay.test.ts:79`) says a late frame from the old camera is "dropped (and closed)". The test never checks that, and the relay's close-on-switch branch has no test.

</details>
